userStories.story: As a user, I want to sign in with my credentials, so that I can access the CardDemo application
userStories.trigger: Press ENTER key after entering user ID and password
userStories.expectedBehavior: System validates credentials against USRSEC file and navigates to appropriate menu based on user type (admin or regular user)

userStories.story: As a user, I want to see error messages for invalid sign-in attempts, so that I know what went wrong
userStories.trigger: Press ENTER with invalid or missing credentials
userStories.expectedBehavior: System displays specific error message (e.g., 'User not found', 'Invalid password')

userStories.story: As a user, I want to clear the sign-in form, so that I can start over
userStories.trigger: Press PF4 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System clears all input fields and redisplays empty sign-on screen

userStories.story: As a regular user, I want to view the main menu, so that I can navigate to different application functions
userStories.trigger: Successfully sign in as a regular user
userStories.expectedBehavior: System displays main menu with options: Account, Card, Bill Payment, Transaction, Report

userStories.story: As a regular user, I want to select a menu option, so that I can access specific functionality
userStories.trigger: Enter option number (1-5) and press ENTER
userStories.expectedBehavior: System validates selection and navigates to selected function (Account=1, Card=2, Bill Pay=3, Transaction=4, Report=5)

userStories.story: As a regular user, I want to return to sign-on screen, so that I can sign out or switch users
userStories.trigger: Press PF3 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System returns to sign-on screen (COSGN00C)

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to view the admin menu, so that I can navigate to administrative functions
userStories.trigger: Successfully sign in as an admin user
userStories.expectedBehavior: System displays admin menu with options: Account, Card, Bill Payment, Transaction, User Administration, Report

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to select a menu option, so that I can access administrative functionality
userStories.trigger: Enter option number (1-6) and press ENTER
userStories.expectedBehavior: System validates selection and navigates to selected function (Account=1, Card=2, Bill Pay=3, Transaction=4, User Admin=5, Report=6)

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to return to sign-on screen, so that I can sign out
userStories.trigger: Press PF3 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System returns to sign-on screen (COSGN00C)

userStories.story: As a user, I want to view account details, so that I can see my account information
userStories.trigger: Navigate from main menu or enter account ID and press ENTER
userStories.expectedBehavior: System retrieves and displays account details including ID, status, balance, credit limit, open date, and expiration date from ACCTDAT file

userStories.story: As a user, I want to navigate to account update screen, so that I can modify account information
userStories.trigger: Press PF5 key while viewing account details
userStories.expectedBehavior: System navigates to account update screen (COACTUPC) with current account data

userStories.story: As a user, I want to return to main menu, so that I can access other functions
userStories.trigger: Press PF3 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System returns to main menu

userStories.story: As a user, I want to update account information, so that I can modify account details
userStories.trigger: Press PF5 key after modifying account fields
userStories.expectedBehavior: System validates modified fields and updates ACCTDAT file with new information
validationStates: Expiration date must be after open date

userStories.story: As a user, I want to cancel account update, so that I can discard changes without saving
userStories.trigger: Press PF3 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System returns to account view (COACTVWC) without saving changes

userStories.story: As a user, I want to clear the account update form, so that I can reset all fields to original values
userStories.trigger: Press PF4 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System reloads original account data and redisplays account update screen

userStories.story: As a user, I want to view a list of credit cards, so that I can see all cards associated with an account
userStories.trigger: Enter account ID and press ENTER
userStories.expectedBehavior: System retrieves and displays list of credit cards from CARDDAT file filtered by account ID

userStories.story: As a user, I want to select a card from the list, so that I can view or update card details
userStories.trigger: Enter selection number and press PF5
userStories.expectedBehavior: System navigates to card detail/update screen (COCRDUPC) with selected card data

userStories.story: As a user, I want to return to main menu, so that I can access other functions
userStories.trigger: Press PF3 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System returns to main menu

userStories.story: As a user, I want to search for credit card details by account and card number, so that I can view specific card information
userStories.trigger: Press ENTER key after entering account number and optional card number
userStories.expectedBehavior: System validates account number (11 digits) and card number (16 digits if provided), retrieves card data from CARDDAT file, and displays card name, active status, and expiry date
validationStates: Account number must be a non zero 11 digit number
Card number if supplied must be a 16 digit number
Did not find this account in cards database
Did not find cards for this search condition

userStories.story: As a user, I want to view card details when coming from card list, so that I can see detailed information for a selected card
userStories.trigger: Navigate from card list screen (COCRDLIC) after selecting a card
userStories.expectedBehavior: System displays pre-populated card details including card number, name on card, active status (Y/N), and expiry date (MM/YYYY)

userStories.story: As a user, I want to exit the card selection screen, so that I can return to the previous screen or main menu
userStories.trigger: Press PF3 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System returns to calling program or main menu (COMEN01C)

userStories.story: As a user, I want to update credit card information, so that I can modify card details
userStories.trigger: Press PF5 key after modifying card fields
userStories.expectedBehavior: System validates modified fields and updates CARDDAT file with new card information
validationStates: Invalid card number format (must be 16 digits)

userStories.story: As a user, I want to cancel card update, so that I can discard changes without saving
userStories.trigger: Press PF3 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System returns to card list (COCRDLIC) without saving changes

userStories.story: As a user, I want to clear the card update form, so that I can reset all fields
userStories.trigger: Press PF4 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System reloads original card data and redisplays card update screen

userStories.story: As a user, I want to view a list of transactions, so that I can see transaction history
userStories.trigger: Enter account ID and press ENTER, or navigate from main menu
userStories.expectedBehavior: System retrieves and displays paginated list of transactions from TRANSACT file filtered by account ID

userStories.story: As a user, I want to navigate through transaction pages, so that I can view all transactions
userStories.trigger: Press PF7 for previous page or PF8 for next page
userStories.expectedBehavior: System displays previous or next page of transactions

userStories.story: As a user, I want to select a transaction, so that I can view transaction details
userStories.trigger: Enter selection number and press ENTER
userStories.expectedBehavior: System navigates to transaction detail screen (COTRN01C) with selected transaction data

userStories.story: As a user, I want to return to main menu, so that I can access other functions
userStories.trigger: Press PF3 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System returns to main menu

userStories.story: As a user, I want to view transaction details, so that I can see complete information about a transaction
userStories.trigger: Navigate from transaction list after selecting a transaction
userStories.expectedBehavior: System displays detailed transaction information including ID, type, category, source, amount, and timestamp from TRANSACT file

userStories.story: As a user, I want to return to transaction list, so that I can view other transactions
userStories.trigger: Press PF3 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System returns to transaction list (COTRN00C)

userStories.story: As a user, I want to add a new transaction, so that I can record transaction activity
userStories.trigger: Press PF5 key after entering transaction details
userStories.expectedBehavior: System validates transaction fields and inserts new transaction into TRANSACT file

userStories.story: As a user, I want to cancel transaction addition, so that I can discard the new transaction without saving
userStories.trigger: Press PF3 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System returns to transaction list (COTRN00C) without saving new transaction

userStories.story: As a user, I want to clear the transaction form, so that I can start over
userStories.trigger: Press PF4 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System clears all input fields and redisplays empty transaction form

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to view a list of users, so that I can manage user accounts
userStories.trigger: Navigate from admin menu
userStories.expectedBehavior: System retrieves and displays paginated list of users from USRSEC file

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to navigate through user pages, so that I can view all users
userStories.trigger: Press PF7 for previous page or PF8 for next page
userStories.expectedBehavior: System displays previous or next page of users

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to add a new user, so that I can create user accounts
userStories.trigger: Press PF5 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System navigates to add user screen (COUSR01C)

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to update a user, so that I can modify user information
userStories.trigger: Enter selection number and press PF6
userStories.expectedBehavior: System navigates to update user screen (COUSR02C) with selected user data

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to delete a user, so that I can remove user accounts
userStories.trigger: Enter selection number and press PF9
userStories.expectedBehavior: System navigates to delete user screen (COUSR03C) with selected user data

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to return to admin menu, so that I can access other administrative functions
userStories.trigger: Press PF3 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System returns to admin menu

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to add a new user, so that I can create user accounts with credentials
userStories.trigger: Press PF5 key after entering user details
userStories.expectedBehavior: System validates user fields and inserts new user into USRSEC file

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to cancel user addition, so that I can discard the new user without saving
userStories.trigger: Press PF3 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System returns to user list (COUSR00C) without saving new user

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to clear the user form, so that I can start over
userStories.trigger: Press PF4 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System clears all input fields and redisplays empty user form

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to update user information, so that I can modify user account details
userStories.trigger: Press PF5 key after modifying user fields
userStories.expectedBehavior: System validates modified fields and updates USRSEC file with new user information

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to cancel user update, so that I can discard changes without saving
userStories.trigger: Press PF3 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System returns to user list (COUSR00C) without saving changes

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to clear the user update form, so that I can reset all fields to original values
userStories.trigger: Press PF4 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System reloads original user data and redisplays user update screen

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to delete a user, so that I can remove user accounts
userStories.trigger: Press PF5 key to confirm deletion
userStories.expectedBehavior: System deletes user record from USRSEC file and returns to user list

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to cancel user deletion, so that I can keep the user account
userStories.trigger: Press PF3 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System returns to user list (COUSR00C) without deleting user

userStories.story: As a user, I want to view authorization summary, so that I can see overview of authorization requests
userStories.trigger: Navigate from main menu and press ENTER
userStories.expectedBehavior: System retrieves authorization summary data from IMS database and displays statistics including total requests, approved, declined, and pending

userStories.story: As a user, I want to view detailed authorization records, so that I can see individual authorization transactions
userStories.trigger: Press PF5 key to navigate to detail screen
userStories.expectedBehavior: System navigates to authorization detail screen (COPAUS1C)

userStories.story: As a user, I want to refresh authorization data, so that I can see updated information
userStories.trigger: Press PF4 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System refreshes authorization summary from IMS database and redisplays screen

userStories.story: As a user, I want to return to main menu, so that I can access other functions
userStories.trigger: Press PF3 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System returns to main menu

userStories.story: As a user, I want to view authorization detail records, so that I can see individual transaction details
userStories.trigger: Navigate from authorization summary screen
userStories.expectedBehavior: System retrieves and displays paginated list of authorization detail records from IMS database including card number, transaction amount, merchant, and status

userStories.story: As a user, I want to navigate through authorization detail pages, so that I can view all authorization records
userStories.trigger: Press PF7 for previous page or PF8 for next page
userStories.expectedBehavior: System displays previous or next page of authorization detail records

userStories.story: As a user, I want to check fraud status for an authorization, so that I can see if transaction was flagged
userStories.trigger: System automatically invokes fraud check via COPAUS2C for each displayed record
userStories.expectedBehavior: System calls DB2 fraud check program and displays fraud indicator (Y/N) for each authorization record

userStories.story: As a user, I want to return to authorization summary, so that I can view overview statistics
userStories.trigger: Press PF3 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System returns to authorization summary screen (COPAUS0C)

userStories.story: As a user, I want to make a bill payment, so that I can pay my credit card bill
userStories.trigger: Enter account ID, payment amount, and press PF5
userStories.expectedBehavior: System validates payment details and processes payment by updating account balance in ACCTDAT file
validationStates: Amount must be greater than zero

userStories.story: As a user, I want to cancel bill payment, so that I can discard the payment without processing
userStories.trigger: Press PF3 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System returns to main menu without processing payment

userStories.story: As a user, I want to clear the payment form, so that I can start over
userStories.trigger: Press PF4 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System clears all input fields and redisplays empty payment form

userStories.story: As a user, I want to generate a report, so that I can view transaction or account information
userStories.trigger: Select report type, enter date range, and press PF5
userStories.expectedBehavior: System validates report parameters and generates requested report from TRANSACT and ACCTDAT files
validationStates: End date must be after start date

userStories.story: As a user, I want to cancel report generation, so that I can return without generating a report
userStories.trigger: Press PF3 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System returns to main menu without generating report

userStories.story: As a user, I want to clear the report form, so that I can start over
userStories.trigger: Press PF4 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System clears all input fields and redisplays empty report form

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to view a list of transaction types, so that I can manage transaction type definitions
userStories.trigger: Navigate from admin menu
userStories.expectedBehavior: System retrieves and displays paginated list of transaction types from DB2 TRANSACTION_TYPE table including type code and description

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to navigate through transaction type pages, so that I can view all types
userStories.trigger: Press PF7 for previous page or PF8 for next page
userStories.expectedBehavior: System displays previous or next page of transaction types

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to update a transaction type, so that I can modify type definitions
userStories.trigger: Enter selection number and press PF5
userStories.expectedBehavior: System navigates to transaction type update screen (COTRTUPC) with selected type data

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to return to admin menu, so that I can access other administrative functions
userStories.trigger: Press PF3 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System returns to admin menu

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to update transaction type information, so that I can modify type code or description
userStories.trigger: Press PF5 key after modifying transaction type fields
userStories.expectedBehavior: System validates modified fields and updates DB2 TRANSACTION_TYPE table with new information
validationStates: Transaction Type Code is required (2 characters)

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to add a new transaction type, so that I can create new type definitions
userStories.trigger: Press PF5 key on empty form with new type code and description
userStories.expectedBehavior: System validates fields, inserts new transaction type into DB2 TRANSACTION_TYPE table, and displays confirmation
validationStates: Transaction Type Code is required (2 characters)

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to cancel transaction type update, so that I can discard changes without saving
userStories.trigger: Press PF12 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System returns to transaction type list (COTRTLIC) without saving changes

userStories.story: As an admin user, I want to clear the transaction type form, so that I can start over
userStories.trigger: Press PF4 key
userStories.expectedBehavior: System clears all input fields and redisplays empty transaction type screen
